description: [Payment decision: spend policy + seller reputation risk check, one verdict] Use right before an agent pays an invoice, merchant or x402 seller: runs the spend-policy check (limits, rolling cap, categories, allow/deny lists, hours, assets/chains, approval threshold) and the seller reputation check (public Base USDC history: buyers, wash share, age, concentration) and returns one verdict pay / dont_pay / ask_human with reasons and one signed receipt. Deterministic; stateless; never pays anyone; not charged if seller data is unavailable. Paid: $0.02 USDC on Base, paid in-band via x402 MCP (@x402/mcp; _meta "x402/payment"). Also at POST https://micro-saas-agent.onrender.com/api/pay/should-i-pay.
